synthesis: The Scout Admin app (Bird's Eye, adminMode) and the Scout User app (driver PWA) render their date-range filter pills from two different arrays in resources/js/clarity-scout/lib/formatters.js. Admin uses rangeOptions = [Today, 7d, 15d, 30d, 60d]; the driver uses driverRangeOptions = [Today, Yesterday, 7d]. The ticket standardizes BOTH to the identical set in order: Today (default), Yesterday, 7d, 15d, 30d — removing 60d from Admin and adding 15d/30d to the driver. Today stays the default/live selection. The backend range->window mapping already supports every target value (today, yesterday, last_7, last_15, last_30) on all surfaces, so the change is primarily the frontend option arrays plus aligned prefetch defaults; no backend behavior change is required for correctness.

scope.summary: Standardize the two frontend date-range option arrays (and the aligned admin prefetch default) so Admin and Scout User apps show Today/Yesterday/7d/15d/30d, default Today. Backend already supports all values.

proposed_changes.change: Set rangeOptions to [Today, Yesterday, 7d, 15d, 30d] (remove 60d, insert Yesterday at position 2). Extend driverRangeOptions to the same 5 entries. Update the stale docblock (currently explains the intentional decoupling) to note DEV-2306 standardization.
proposed_changes.reason: Core requirement — both apps' filter pills come from these arrays.

proposed_changes.change: prefetchAllRanges default allRanges: ['today','last_7','last_15','last_30','last_60'] -> ['today','yesterday','last_7','last_15','last_30'] (drop last_60, add yesterday) to match the standardized admin set.
proposed_changes.reason: Admin prefetch-warm set must match the new pill set so switching stays instant and no longer warms the removed 60d window.

proposed_changes.change: Zoom-snap list ['last_15','last_30','last_60'] -> ['last_15','last_30'] (last_60 is no longer selectable). Confirm the adminMode ternary still resolves correctly (both arrays now identical -> effectively a no-op; leave or unify per DECISION Q1).
proposed_changes.reason: last_60 removed from UI; keep the heavy-window zoom-snap list accurate.

proposed_changes.change: Driver prefetch must STAY light (today/yesterday/7d) even though driverRangeOptions now has 5 entries. Stop deriving the driver warm-set from driverRangeOptions (that would warm 15/30); use a dedicated light list instead — a new named export driverPrefetchRanges = ['today','yesterday','last_7'] in formatters.js.
proposed_changes.reason: Dalton's decision: keep driver mobile-light (DEV-2186); 15/30 fetch on-demand when tapped. Decouples 'pills shown' from 'windows warmed'.

questions.q: After standardization the Admin and Scout User pill sets are identical (Today/Yesterday/7d/15d/30d). (a) Should the driver PWA now BACKGROUND-PREFETCH the newly-added 15d/30d stat windows (reversing DEV-2186's deliberate mobile-lightness), or keep prefetch light and fetch 15/30 on-demand when tapped? (b) Structure: unify into one shared array, or keep two now-identical named exports? These are coupled via usePrefetch.js's use of driverRangeOptions.
questions.answer: (a) Keep driver prefetch LIGHT — driver shows all 5 pills but background-warms only today/yesterday/7d; 15/30 fetch on-demand when tapped (preserves DEV-2186). (b) Keep two named exports rangeOptions + driverRangeOptions, both set to the identical standardized 5-entry set. Consequence: usePrefetch uses a dedicated light list (new driverPrefetchRanges), NOT driverRangeOptions.

notes: Bird's Eye admin reuses the real Scout App.vue + DateRangeControl via adminMode (DEV-2116), so 'Admin app' filter == rangeOptions; 'Scout User app' == driverRangeOptions. Single frontend surface, two arrays.
Knowledge card clarity/scout.md warns driver+admin share dashboard.js + DashboardOverlay — 'driver unchanged' assumptions are fragile; verify the driver view after the shared-code edit.

Platform has no JS test runner (built assets are committed). The testable seam is a PHPUnit feature test on the Scout stat endpoints asserting the standardized range set maps to correct windows; frontend pills verified in browser QA.
Scout dashboard scan/hit stats read ClickHouse (stats endpoints) -> AC4 verification is CH-backed; QA should provision CH (QA_PROVISION_CH=yes). The code change itself does NOT modify any CH query.

tests.what_it_pins: Scout dashboard + Bird's Eye stat endpoints accept each standardized range (today,yesterday,last_7,last_15,last_30) and resolve the expected date-window boundaries; unknown/removed last_60 collapses gracefully to today.

grounding.code_flow: DateRangeControl renders visibleRangeOptions (rangeOptions if adminMode else driverRangeOptions). Tapping a pill -> dashboard.setRange(value) -> fetchStats(range)/fetchRecentHits(range) -> Scout API controllers map range->[start,end] window (ScoutMapHelpers::rangeWindow / DashboardController) -> stat/hit queries. Backend allow-lists already include yesterday/last_15/last_30/last_60.
